scope: Contract-first UI/caller/export peer, no original interpolation model or course exposure

cases.expect: Sample x/y raw tokens remain distinct literal strings and authored row order reaches the unchanged model; no sorting, Number conversion, whitespace trim or query/sample concatenation by the UI.

Wholly blank query text creates zero queries; an inner blank row among nonblank coordinates is passed/refused as a blank coordinate rather than silently dropped. Empty string and zero are not conflated.

A valid accepted report/observation becomes unavailable on every sample/query edit, add/remove and preset selection. Invalid Apply cannot retain old output or activate a previous download. Course/guide remain available independently.

Observation serialization uses only the authentic current model report, all exact report fields, raw inputs and all query classifications, not values reconstructed from visible DOM, subset or plotted coordinates. Methodical source changes cannot mutate the accepted report through live draft arrays.
All literal sample/query/lesson metadata uses text-safe rendering. An approximate SVG never supplies exact classification or error claims; absent finite geometry does not suppress exact output.

Course and Markdown downloads preserve exact frozen source bytes regardless of current invalid draft; observation/course/guide are distinct artifact kinds. Builder escaping protects literal content and produces exact reproducible bytes.
